import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
def one(name,w,auth=(0,0,0)):
 r=run(trace([{'keys':['I','H','A']},datagram(w,auth)]))['traces'][0]
 print('\n',name,'wire',w.hex())
 print([(p['packet'],p['offset'],p['level'],p['pn'],p['status']) for p in r['packets']])
 print(r['datagrams'],r['closed'])
 return r
good=envelope('I',0,b'\x01')
# append bad long version
one('valid+badver',good+bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\2')
# good + truncated next
one('valid+trunc',good+b'\xc0')
# two good then bad at second
one('two+bad',good+envelope('I',1,b'\x01')+b'\xc0')
# bad flags first but valid after? bad abandons so only bad
one('badflag',bytes([0xd0])+b'\0\0\0\1')
# short bad flags, ensure row null exper
one('shortbad',bytes([0x00,0xaa,0x00]))
# short truncated cid
one('shorttrunc',bytes([0x40,0xaa]))
# short good then extra ignored as payload; ping+ping etc
one('shortpayload',bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00])+b'\x01\x01')
# long dcid length >20
one('dcid21',bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([21])+bytes(21))
# initial token huge
one('tokhuge',bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\0\0'+b'\x40\xff')
# length less pn width
one('lenbad',bytes([0xc3])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\0\0'+b'\x00'+b'\x02'+b'\0\0')
